note: Thread standards set by Luke on 28 Sep 2026: the main thread row of every record carries the standard for its garment type (chef jacket 220 m, chef trousers 150 m, bib apron 70 m, waist apron 30 m). A second thread row (contrast colour) keeps its own figure. Set threadOwn:true on a record to keep a figure that differs from the standard. The styles below are every baked-in record with a thread row, thread quantity set.

trims: Red thread for bartack and bottom buttonhole
Oliver harvey made in england tape
White - set to back neck. (from shoulder to shoulder seam)
Set 7.5cm cm up from cut hem left side seam as worn.(to be 6cm from finished hem)
Oliver harvey woven label back neck
Wash instruction - 50% polyester 50% tencel - 70 degree/2 dot iron/ low tumble dry/ p dry clean/do not bleach / Right hand side inside seam
Oliver Harvey kraft swing tag 50x75mm — fix through the garment label. Removed by customer.
mfg: Fuse collar and collar stand. set fusible 6mm from top edge. make and set collar and collar stand. 6mm seam. 1cm seam at neck. follow edge of fusible when making up collar. use small stitch when sewing and edgestitch collar stand. 6mm topstitch collar leaf edge. top collar and top undercollar to be fused
Set darts. stitch from bottom at notch 1mm seam up for 2cm and then gradually out to waist steck holes and back to nothing 1cm past top steck hole
Double turn using notches front edges. front edge to stitching to be 3cm. edgestitch front edge

Make and set pocket and flap. overlock top edge of pocket and turn 1.5cm and topsttich down. set pocket left side as worn. (use marker- set pocket 19cm down from shoulder neck point and front side of pocket in line with shoulder neck point). pocket to be parallel to front placket. edgestitch pocket to jacket. set pen pocket detail - set stitch line 3cm from front side edge of pocket (to compensate for 6mm topstitch of pocket flap - stitch opening at top is 2.5cm)

Make flap. turn through top edge and 6mm topstitch. overlock top edge of pocket flap. take out chain stitch. set pocket flap 1.5cm up from pocket. leave opening 2.5cm in top edge for pen position at inside edge of pocket. 6mm pocket flap down leaving opening. backtack to secure stitching at top to 6mm topstitch detail. leave gap 2.5cm then 6mm topstitch to end of flap. back tack stitching at each end to secure
Bartack vertical in white top of pocket X 3 and bartack vertical in red pen pocket opening through flap
Set yoke to front and back. yoke seams to be enclosed. edgetitch yoke seams
Set OH back neck tape to back neck of yoke shoulder seam to shoulder seam. set OH back neck label to centre back
Set collarstand to neck and edgestitch to neck and all round collar stand
Set sleeves. join underarm seam/side seams. insert tax tab 7.5cm up from cut hem
Set sleeve hem. turn 1cm +2.5cm and topstitch. set sleeves. edgestitch on armhole
Overlock hem . double turn and 6mm topstitch
fin: Mark and set button and buttonholes. check and ensure front lengths are the same before setting buttonholes/buttons. ensure button and buttonholes set centrally within front placket. bottom buttonhole to be in red thread. note set 1 spare button on care label

Set buttonholes - blade 5/8" 15.8mm. use markers for position collar buttonhole set horizontal and set central to depth of collar stand and centre of buttonhole set 2cm from front edge of collar stand. front button holes (vertical) spacing 8cm then 9.5cm spacing
Flap buttonhole set vertical. centre of buttonhole set 2.3cm up from point of flap
To be individually wrapped in OH tissue. Set label to front bottom right hand corner
